source_locator: Maricopa County Final Summary Report, Nov 6 2012, page 16, contest MAYOR - CITY OF GLENDALE
verification_note: Maricopa County Elections final summary for the November 6, 2012 election lists MAYOR - CITY OF GLENDALE: Jerry Weiers 31,509 (53.25 percent), Manuel "Manny" Cruz 27,438 (46.37 percent), write-in 225. The August 28, 2012 primary (same county series, page 81: Weiers 10,835, 45.66 percent; Cruz 7,719; Walt Opaska 5,121) gave no candidate a majority, so under Charter Art. IX Secs. 6-7 the November election was decisive. Read in a browser on 2026-10-02 because the county site blocks automated downloads.

source_locator: Maricopa County Final Summary Report, Aug 30 2016, page 33, contest MAYOR - CITY OF GLENDALE
verification_note: Maricopa County Elections final summary for the August 30, 2016 primary lists MAYOR - CITY OF GLENDALE: Jerry Weiers 13,172 (50.62 percent), Mark Burdick 12,767 (49.06 percent), write-in 83, total 26,022. Weiers won a majority of all votes cast, so under Glendale Charter Art. IX Sec. 6 (majority to elect in primary) he was declared elected at the primary.

source_locator: Maricopa County Final Official Summary Report, Aug 4 2020, page 91, contest Glendale-Mayor (results print above the contest heading in this report layout)
verification_note: Maricopa County Elections final official summary for the August 4, 2020 primary lists Glendale-Mayor: Jerry Weiers 20,222 (53.41 percent), Michelle Robertson 17,539 (46.32 percent), write-in 102; ballots cast 39,369 of 122,387 registered. In this report layout each contest's results appear above its heading (confirmed against the adjacent Gilbert and Glendale council contests). Majority in the primary elects under Glendale Charter Art. IX Sec. 6.
